craft_evidence.reasoning: Caleres' FY2025 10-K states that its own Port Washington, Wisconsin and Santiago, Dominican Republic factories make Allen Edmonds footwear. The brand's process page sets out a specific Port Washington construction (360° Goodyear bench welt, 40,000 lasts, hand finishing). It is held at 4, not 5: the brand's own "Handcrafted in Port Washington" listing implies only part of the range is US-made, no product page read states an origin, the US-made share is unestablished, and the apparel is mostly stocked from other labels.
